name: Enhance Video Models
description: Upscalers for anime, live action and 3D animation, plus a clean-up model that removes compression and noise.
details: Fifteen single-image models run frame by frame on ONNX Runtime: 2x and 4x upscalers for anime and drawings (Adore, Ani4K v2, Balanced, Strong v1.5/v2.5/v3, Real-ESRGAN Anime Video), live action and 3D renders (LiveAction V1, OpenProteus, NomosUni, ClearReality V1, Nomos8k Strong), a general Real-ESRGAN 4x, and GaterV3 for compression clean-up without resizing. Licenses vary by model, including non-commercial ones; see NOTICE.txt. Package id: restore.models.
author: CutWire
